response.inner_monologue: Ten months unemployed. The savings number looks like a lot until you divide it by the burn rate and get twenty-one. Twenty-one months is not forever. The credit union contact was the right move last tick — this week I follow up and I send a second letter somewhere else simultaneously. I have been telling myself I will be ready when the credential is done. The credential will be done when I make it done. I am accelerating. The community is fracturing around me — nine protests, Millfield employment at 53%, spending at 30 — and I am a risk professional who modeled this exact trajectory before almost anyone else in this town. That matters somewhere. I need to find where.
